What a column counts. A client that offers UTF-8 gets it, and a column
is a byte offset in the line; one that does not gets UTF-16 code units.
The line below has characters of two and three bytes (one unit each) and
one of four (two units) before the finding.

-- lib/dgdtools.yml --
-- lib/obj/a.c --
void f() { /* blåbær € 😀 */ a == 1; }
-- script --
initialize utf-8 lib
open lib/obj/a.c
diagnostics lib/obj/a.c
# A change at the finding, in bytes: "==" becomes "=".
change lib/obj/a.c 0:37-0:39 "="
text lib/obj/a.c
diagnostics lib/obj/a.c
shutdown
exit
